item.title: Velocity Group Opens Electronics Manufacturing Plant in Ohio
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, OH – Velocity Group has opened an 80,000-sq.-ft. manufacturing facility in Cambridge, OH, consolidating three previous facilities and tripling the company’s production capacity.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: CACI Opens Defense Electronics Manufacturing Center in New York
item.description: NEW YORK -- CACI International has opened a 61,000-sq.-ft. Manufacturing Center of Excellence for Defense Electronics in Pittsford, NY, expanding the company’s capacity to produce electronic warfare systems for the U.S. military.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: PCB West Panel to Take On What’s Next for PCB Design
item.description: PEACHTREE CITY, GA – AUGUST 18, 2026 – The Printed Circuit Engineering Association (PCEA) today announced a panel discussion on the technologies reshaping printed circuit board design over the next two to five years will take place at PCB West 2026.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Fabrinet Fiscal 2026 Revenue Rises 36% to $4 Billion
item.description: BANGKOK – Fabrinet reported record revenue of $1.3 billion for its fiscal fourth quarter ended June 26, up 44% from $909 million in the same quarter a year ago and exceeding the company's guidance range.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Foxconn Unit Acquires Mexico Land for $20M
item.description: TAIPEI – Hon Hai Precision Industry, better known as Foxconn, announced that subsidiary FII AMC Mexico has acquired land in El Salto, Jalisco, Mexico, for approximately $20 million.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: GPV Q2 Earnings Rise 20% on Operational Improvements
item.description: VEJLE, DENMARK – GPV reported improved second-quarter profitability as operational and structural changes boosted earnings despite continued material availability constraints.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Dixon Technologies Forms Smartphone OEM Subsidiary
item.description: NOIDA, INDIA – Dixon Technologies is establishing a new subsidiary to support its original equipment manufacturing (OEM) business for electronic devices, including smartphones, through a joint venture with Vivo Mobile India.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Kimball Electronics Forecasts Return to Growth in 2027
item.description: JASPER, IN – Kimball Electronics reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 net sales of $371 million, a 5% sequential increase, and provided fiscal 2027 guidance calling for a return to organic sales growth supported by its Helvoet Polymer Technologies acquisition.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Norautron Acquires Jaltek to Expand UK Manufacturing
item.description: HORTEN, NORWAY – Norautron has acquired UK-based electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider Jaltek, expanding its manufacturing footprint into the United Kingdom and strengthening its engineering and production capabilities.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: PCB Market Authority Nakahara to Deliver Industry Outlook at PCB West
item.description: PEACHTREE CITY, GA – The Printed Circuit Engineering Association (PCEA) today announced that Dr. Hayao Nakahara, president of N.T. Information Ltd. and author of the annual NTI-100 ranking of the world’s largest printed circuit board manufacturers, will present “The PCB Market Outlook” at PCB West 2026.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: A Day of Assembly Classes at PCB West 2026
item.description: PEACHTREE CITY, GA – PCB West 2026 offers 11 presentations on circuit assembly processes across two days in September at the Santa Clara (CA) Convention Center.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)

item.title: Susy Webb to Lead Signal Routing Webinar Nov. 4
item.description: PEACHTREE CITY, GA – The Printed Circuit Engineering Association will host a 3.5-hour signal routing webinar on Nov. 4. The webinar, “Designing the Signal Routing to Control Energy in Digital PCBs,” will be presented by PCB design instructor Susy Webb.
item.author: ryann@pcea.net (Ryann Howard)
